tooltip.mistvale_rpg.soul_shard: A splinter of a restless soul.
tooltip.mistvale_rpg.soul_shard.use: Use it on a Caged Soul Block. Three shards break the cage.
message.mistvale_rpg.caged_soul.needs_sh: The soul is caged. It stirs at the touch of a Soul Shard.
message.mistvale_rpg.caged_soul.freed: The cage breaks. The soul of %s is free.
message.mistvale_rpg.charged_soul.waitin: The soul of %s waits. Nine souls together will open the way.
message.mistvale_rpg.soul_platform.no_ro: There is no room above the platform for a rift.
message.mistvale_rpg.soul_platform.fizzl: The power drains away. The platform is broken.
message.mistvale_rpg.rift.leads_nowhere: This rift does not lead anywhere yet, so it spits you out at the world spawn.
message.mistvale_rpg.spirit.greeting: The Spirit tilts her head at you. She has much to tell you, but not yet.
subtitles.mistvale_rpg.warp_arrive: Someone arrives in a burst of light
subtitles.mistvale_rpg.void_arrive: Someone claws out of the void
